verdict.rationale: Event-triggered automation rules are a fair question for a payroll/HR platform, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no user-definable rule or trigger-action engine in Gusto. Webhook subscriptions only deliver events to the partner's own application, which must implement the follow-up logic itself; that makes them a developer building block, not a rules capability. Auto-generated scheduled payrolls are a fixed system behavior, not user-defined rules.
